title: 有馬記念の後に・終わらない栄華

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright wins the Arima Kinen as a shining new light for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may have walked that unending path slowly… but she has arrived at the summit nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells the crowd about what is unique to the Mejiros, what they have protected until now, and their story that is now unfolding into a new age.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright, dazzling like a star, becomes worthy of admiration not only as a Mejiro but as an Umamusume.
